notes.title: Support Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers on Kickstarter Today
notes.content: [p]Would you like to contribute to the full release of our game?[/p][p]Follow our project and get ready to support us when the Kickstarter campaign begins![/p][p]By backing our campaign, you’ll not only help bring Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers to life, but also unlock exclusive rewards including early bird discounts, unique cosmetics, early access to the game, and more.[/p][p]Support us on Kickstarter and be among the first to experience the full game, with special items and bonuses available only before release![/p][p]Follow our project and click the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kickforge/eilean-mor-the-lost-keepers"]“Notify Me on Launch”[/url] button on Kickstarter to be ready when the campaign begins![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kickforge/eilean-mor-the-lost-keepers"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kickforge/eilean-mor-the-lost-keepers[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700898/7f7b81f0dfd1d76c638278f4fc2f4d011dfef8e0.png"][/img][/p]
